Quick note on process so we're transparent: Redwood generally requires a PO for vendor spend, but we do have an invoice-only path for short pilots under our discretionary threshold. Priya (cc'd) is our procurement lead and will advise on the evidence we need and the approval flow.

To keep things moving, please send W9 and your vendor contact, and we will start the vendor setup form. Hi team — copying procurement rules & next steps to make this actionable.

Summary of policy (short):
- Standard: PO required for vendor spend unless exempted.
- Discretionary invoice-only path: available for one-time engagements or pilots where total expected spend < $2,500 and duration < 90 days, with manager approval and finance acknowledgement.
- Thresholds: PO required for recurring or scale scenarios or if any single invoice > $2,500.

What we need from Bright Data to evaluate an exception:
1) Completed vendor_setup_form.pdf (attached)
2) W9 (tax) and remit/billing contact
3) Short SOW describing deliverables and acceptance criteria
4) Evidence checklist (insurance, DUNS if available; SOC2 summary if you have one)

If Mina and I agree the pilot fits the discretionary path, I will route a waiver request to Marissa for expedited approval and notify finance. Please attach documents to this thread or upload to the HubSpot deal (link below).

Attachment: vendor_setup_form.pdf
Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/BD-9082

Thanks,
